title: The Forever Club
subtitle: Four Girls. One Universe. Infinite Memories.

timeCapsule.letterTitle: To Kahean, Líng Lëé, Jia Qi & yimin_04 in 2030
timeCapsule.letterBody:
Four Girls. One Universe.

If you are reading this unlocked capsule, years have passed since 2026. Wherever your careers, cities, and lives have carried you, remember the nights we spent dreaming about the future and laughing until late.

Open the group chat today. Plan the next mamak summit. Nothing truly ends when four stars share the same sky.

Est. Forever — The Forever Club

poemLines: Of all the stars in the universe,
but always under the same sky.
